newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai two largest accounting societies merge.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai two largest accounting societies merge.

text.p: Shanghai's two largest accounting societies, the Shanghai Chartered Accountants' Association and the Shanghai Social Audit Association, have merged, the official Wen Hui Bao newspaper said on Thursday.
The newspaper did not give the name of the new body.
The merger is aiming at strengthening the function of chartered accountants in the development of the local economy and will help to more closely regulate their work, it said.

The newspaper quoted vice mayor Chen Liangyu as saying a first-class city needed the best chartered accountants and accounting institutions, which should be developed into large-scale, international bodies.
